name: sorafenib
indications_original: Sorafenib is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of • Unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma ( 1.1 ) • Advanced renal cell carcinoma ( 1.2 ) • Locally recurrent or metastatic, progressive, differentiated thyroid carcinoma (DTC) refractory to radioactive iodine treatment ( 1.3 )
contraindications_original: The recommended dosage is 400 mg orally twice daily without food. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Sorafenib tablets USP, 200 mg are supplied as light yellow to yellow colour, round, biconvex, film-coated tablets debossed with ‘I’ on one side and plain on the other side and free from physical defects. 
                   Bottles of 120 tablets NDC 43598-458-04 
                  Bottles of 360 tablets NDC 43598-458-36 
                  Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F); excursions permitted to 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Store in a dry place.
adverseReactions_original:
• Sorafenib tablets are contraindicated in patients with known severe hypersensitivity to sorafenib or any other component of sorafenib tablets. 
                  • Sorafenib tablets in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel is contraindicated in patients with squamous cell lung cancer [see Warnings and Precautions (
                     5.8
                     )].
